caveats: KY PARSER REGRESSION — SAMPLING, NOT A CODE REGRESSION, AND NOT CAUSED BY THE NEW REPAIRS. 9 of 26 KY rows failed on exactly three fields each (sub_strand.code, indicator.code, standard_id). The parser left the detector's label-form sub_strand code unconverted ('Benchmark 1.1' where the golden wants 'LEL.1.1') and emitted a bare indicator code ('AAPWI' for 'LEL.1.1.AAPWI'). The detection INPUT is byte-identical between this run and the 288c64f1 baseline (same 44 elements, same codes at every level), and all 9 failures sit in a single domain (LEL) while AL and HMW are clean — parsing batches by domain, so this is one parser call sampling badly. The parser prompt was not changed between the two hashes.

_qualify_bare_indicator_code DECLINED these rows by design: its malformed-ancestor guard refuses to prefix a whitespace-bearing ancestor, because doing so would inject whitespace into the primary key and swap a 'not nested' rejection for a 'whitespace' one. Removing the guard would NOT recover the golden — it would produce 'Benchmark 1.1.AAPWI'. In production all 9 rows would be rejected by validator._validate_code_shape and never reach Aurora; the eval does not run the validator, so it scores them as field errors.

ATTRIBUTION IS NOT ISOLATED. The improvement lies inside 288c64f1 -> 7da92182, but two changes in that window can move NV detection: the Pass-1 layout-stratified sampler (99b853cc; NV is over the token budget and samples, and the new sample spans pages 1-15 vs 1-12 with 32 buckets vs 29) and rule 4's 'code is REQUIRED, never null' prompt clarification (b35b9666). The parser repairs cannot affect this arm, and the widened _DERIVABLE_CODE_RE cannot either since TECH is 4 chars and already matched the old {1,5} bound. An A/B is needed to separate them.

The batched run outputs/08-22-26-4 produced S/SS/T on 2026-08-22 while the direct-path recording the same day (288c64f1) still emitted Science/TECH. That is the direct-vs-batched divergence, not evidence that the fix predates this week.

NV's SS domain code still passes BY COINCIDENCE — derive_code_from_title('Social Studies') happens to return SS (see task2_20260816/findings.md section 4). A change to derive_code_from_title or the connector list turns 46/46 into 45/46 with nothing else moving.

GUARDRAIL 8 STILL APPLIES TO NV. Raw precision 0.8846 is not a hallucination rate; 5 of the 6 in-scope non-golden detections are correct re-detections of headings the document reprints on a second page spread. NV keeps the verified-precision path. KY remains the one detection-exhaustive golden (44 golden vs 44 in-scope), so its raw precision 1.0000 is a real hallucination rate.

The description 2/3 -> 3/3 move is on the DIRECT path, where CLAUDE.md records _splice_overlapping_prose as inert. The splice is therefore NOT the cause; the changed Pass-1 sample is the likeliest one. One run, not isolated.

The ICOPPPTM over-long-code defect that motivated 7da92182 does not appear in this arm — KY's direct-path run coded ICOPP correctly at both hashes. It was a batched-path observation (pipeline run 043).

open_defect.summary: The parser intermittently fails to convert a detector label-form parent code ('Benchmark N.N') into the domain-prefixed form ('LEL.N.N'), and the leaf then goes bare. Affects standard_id, so it is a malformed primary key.
open_defect.candidate_repair: Deterministic de-label: a parent code shaped '<token-with-no-leading-digit> <dotted-numeric-id>' is the label form, and rebuilds as '<resolved domain code>.<id>'. Shape-only, no label-word list.
open_defect.measured: Repairs 9/9 of the failing KY sub_strand codes exactly. Changes ZERO codes across all six parser goldens (106 standards) and ZERO of 1974 codes across two full six-state production runs. Composes with the existing _qualify_bare_indicator_code: once the ancestor is well-formed the bare leaf qualifies to 'LEL.1.1.AAPWI', taking all 9 rows to the golden and KY back to 26/26.
open_defect.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Proposed; needs the usual validation pass and a hash-busting window.
